sections.heading: Office technology for Muncie's health care, education and manufacturing employers
sections.subhead: Muncie is the Delaware County seat, about 50 miles northeast of Indianapolis, home to Ball State University and IU Health Ball Memorial Hospital. VAF supports Muncie from its Indianapolis headquarters with phones, networks, managed IT and print.

sections.heading: Muncie: Ball State, Ball Memorial and a manufacturing history
sections.body: Muncie's glass-making and manufacturing past began with the gas boom of the 1880s, and the Ball family legacy still shows in Ball State University and Ball Memorial Hospital, now part of IU Health. Those two institutions are the city's largest employers. VAF has no Muncie office. We serve Muncie from the Indianapolis headquarters, about 50 miles away, with the computer-dispatched service fleet.

sections.heading: Phones, carriers and networks across a campus or a plant
sections.body: Sites with several buildings meet the same problems: phones that stop at the door, carrier bills nobody has audited, and networks added one closet at a time. VAF has been in the telecom business since 1983, with more than 4,000 systems deployed and Mitel Gold status seven years running. Its vendor-neutral carrier evaluation covers SD-WAN, SIP trunking, broadband and fixed wireless, so you get one bill and one point of contact.
